checks.stdout:
spaCR modules that can run headless:

  mask             Segment cells / nuclei / pathogens with Cellpose and write merged stacks.
                   -> spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks()
  timelapse        Mask pipeline with object tracking across the frames of a time series.
                   -> spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks_timelapse()
  motility         Automated motility assay: per-track velocity plus infection QC.
                   -> spacr.timelapse.automated_motility_assay()
  measure          Measure per-object morphology / intensity and crop single-object PNGs.
                   -> spacr.measure.measure_crop()
  align            Register and stitch an arbitrary number of tiles into one canvas.
                   -> spacr.align.align_folder()
  ops              Stitch, segment and decode the wells of an optical pooled screen's sequencing acquisition.
                   -> spacr.ops_engine.run_ops()
  foreign          Import external images, masks, and a measurement table as a spaCR project.
                   -> spacr.foreign.import_project()
  external_masks   Measure images using label masks generated outside spaCR.
                   -> spacr.external_masks.prepare_external_masks()
  classify         Full DL pipeline: build dataset, train, apply the model, merge predictions.
                   -> spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr()
  classify_merged  Train a classifier on single objects: Torch on crops, or gradient boosting on measured features.
                   -> spacr.classify.classify()
  train_only       The training stage alone: train / evaluate on an existing dataset folder.
                   -> spacr.deep_spacr.train_test_model()
  activation       Generate class-activation maps for a trained classifier.
                   -> spacr.deep_spacr.generate_activation_map()
  umap             Embed single-object images with UMAP and plot them as image glyphs.
                   -> spacr.core.generate_image_umap()
  ml_analyze       Classical ML (XGBoost / RF / logistic) on per-object screen features.
                   -> spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores()
  regression       Regress per-well scores against sgRNA counts to call screen hits.
                   -> spacr.ml.perform_regression()
  explain_cv       Explain existing CV predictions with measured object features.
                   -> spacr.surrogate.run_explain_cv()
  investigate_hit  Resolve one exact regression hit to cross-fitted candidate cells.
                   -> spacr.hit_investigation.investigate_hit()
  map_barcodes     Map row / column / gRNA barcodes out of sequencing reads onto wells.
                   -> spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping()
  recruitment      Analyze recruitment of a channel of interest to pathogen compartments.
                   -> spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment()
  invasion         Red/green invasion assay: score every parasite attached or invaded, per well.
                   -> spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion()
  replication      Count parasites per vacuole and compare replication distributions.
                   -> spacr.submodules.analyze_replication()
  endodyogeny      Legacy size proxy: bin pathogen area-derived volume by doublings.
                   -> spacr.submodules.analyze_endodyogeny()
  analyze_plaques  Segment and quantify plaques in a plaque assay.
                   -> spacr.submodules.analyze_plaques()
  train_cellpose   Train or fine-tune a Cellpose model on your own labelled images.
                   -> spacr.submodules.train_cellpose()
  cellpose_masks   Run one Cellpose model over a folder and save the masks.
                   -> spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune()
  convert          Convert vendor images into mapped, collision-safe Yokogawa TIFFs.
                   -> spacr.convert.convert_folder()
  illumination     Estimate the plate's illumination field and install the correction every measure worker applies.
                   -> spacr.illumination.prepare_illumination_correction()
  barcode_qc       QC a barcode-mapping run and derive its abundance threshold from a gRNAs-per-well target.
                   -> spacr.sequencing_qc.barcode_qc()
  simulation       Sweep the pooled-screen simulator across a grid of parameters.
                   -> spacr.sim.run_multiple_simulations()
  anndata_export   Export the measurement tables as AnnData (.h5ad) for scanpy and scvi-tools.
                   -> spacr.anndata_export.run_anndata_export()

GUI-only (no headless equivalent):
  agreement        Annotator Agreement is an interactive review of the crops two annotators disagreed on; headless, call spacr.agreement.agreement_report + format_agreement from Python.
  annotate         Annotate paints labels onto a grid of single-object images by hand; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt) — there is no batch equivalent.
  batch            Batch Runner is the GUI for building a queue file. Headless, run the queue itself: from spacr.batch import load_queue, run_queue; run_queue(load_queue('night.queue.json'), path='night.queue.json') -- each job in it is a spacr-run invocation.
  classifier_evaluation  Classifier Evaluation is an interactive results workbench; headless, call spacr.classifier_evaluation.evaluate_predictions or load_evaluation_bundle from Python instead.
  control_chart    For headless use, call spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.control_chart(frame, spec) to return the same limits, violations, and report text.
  curate           Curate is hand correction of a mask or a track table -- the brush and the track surgery are the whole feature; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is a button on Make Masks. Headless, spacr.curation.MaskCuration and TrackCuration make the same edits with the same ledger.
  data_manager     Data Manager shows what a project costs in disk and makes you read the deletion before it happens, which is the whole point of it -- so there is deliberately no one-shot headless delete. From Python: spacr.data_manager.scan_project(src) for the per-kind sizes, plan_prune(src) for exactly what is regenerable and what is being kept, then prune(plan, confirm=plan.token) once you have read the plan.
  db_browser       Database Browser is an interactive sqlite viewer; use the sqlite3 CLI or pandas on measurements.db instead.
  distributed_jobs  Distributed Jobs is the interactive monitor. Headless, use the spacr-remote CLI to manage profiles, submit settings, poll logs and cancel jobs instead.
  feature_explorer  For headless use, call spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank.rank_features(frame, spec) to return the same feature-level statistics and ranking.
  hit_list         Hit List is an interactive ranked table — filtering, annotating and clicking through to the cells is the feature; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is a tab on the Regression results and a button on that masthead. Headless, spacr.hits.build_hit_list(...) builds the same ranking, and 'spacr-run investigate_hit' takes one hit back to its wells.
  image_scatter    Image Scatter is an interactive plot — the hover preview is the whole feature; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is a button on Image UMAP. Headless, read the same table with pandas.
  import_images    Image import folded into the foreign-format importer. In the GUI open 'foreign'; headless, call spacr.image_import.apply_import, which is what that screen drives.
  make_masks       Make Masks is a manual mask editor -- the brush, the wand and the recrop are the whole feature, so there is nothing to batch -- but it does open on a folder from a terminal: 'spacr-make-masks --folder <dir>' builds a curation queue over that folder and opens the editor on it. --order easy|prob|value|name chooses what to offer first (easy by default), --limit N ends the session after N fields, and --dry-run prints the queue and its order with no display at all. Progress is kept in <dir>/curate_status.csv, so done and skip survive a restart and travel with the images between machines. From Python, spacr.curation_queue.build_queue(folder) returns the same session.
  methods_export   Use Methods & Results for interactive drafting. In a headless workflow, call spacr.methods_export.build_digest(...), then render_methods(digest) and render_results(digest); these functions need no AI provider.
  model_compare    Model Compare runs two Cellpose models side by side for you to look at; headless, call spacr.model_compare.compare_models.
  model_zoo        Model Zoo is an interactive browser; headless, call spacr.model_zoo.discover_local + format_zoo, and benchmark(entry, source=...) to test one on three fields.
  napari_bridge    Open in napari hands a mask to napari for you to correct by hand and reads it back; the correcting is the feature, so there is nothing to batch. Run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is a button on Make Masks. Headless, spacr.napari_bridge.correct_mask(mask_path, image_path) is the same round trip from Python.
  outliers         For headless use, call spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.detect_outliers() to compute the same object flags, well scores, and report.
  pca              PCA here is interactive multivariate exploration — ticking features and brushing a cluster are the feature; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is a button on Image UMAP. Headless, spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.pca() is the equivalent.
  plate_view       Plate Viewer is an interactive heatmap; headless, call spacr.plate_qc.detect_edge_effect + format_edge_report.
  queue            Plate Queue is a GUI convenience that chains plates through another module. Headless, loop over plates in your batch script and call spacr-run once per plate.
  regression_diagnostics  Regression diagnostics folded into Regression, which writes them as part of its own run. In the GUI open 'regression'; headless, run 'spacr-run regression' — the diagnostics are written beside its output — or call spacr.regression_diagnostics directly.
  report           Report is a one-click document builder; headless, call spacr.report.build_report(src, out, fmt='html').
  run_history      Run History is an interactive searchable dashboard; headless, call spacr.run_journal.search_runs() instead.
  train_compare    Training Runs is an interactive curve/settings comparison; headless, use spacr.train_compare.find_runs + format_comparison from Python.
  trellis          For headless use, call spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.trellis() to compute the panel layout, scales, and per-panel sample sizes.
  volcano_explorer  Volcano Explorer is an interactive reader for a finished regression — clicking a point is the feature, so there is nothing to batch; run it in the GUI (spacr-qt), where it is “Publication figure…” on the Regression volcano and a button on that masthead. Headless, call spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano(results, VolcanoStyle(...), save_path='volcano.pdf'); that is the renderer this screen draws through, so the figure is the same one, vector at publication size.

Run 'spacr-run --describe <module>' for required settings and outputs.
